description: Four independent fades in 6HP, each with its own knob and CV, all moved together by a master control, and each giving a blend and its opposite

params.text: Sets the blend of that section, all A fully counter-clockwise and all B fully clockwise; the master knob is added to all four
Attenuates and inverts that fade CV between -100% and +100%, and is ignored while the jack is in trigger mode
Jumps that fade knob between full A and full B, and works only while nothing is patched into that fade jack
Chooses how the jack beside it is read: as a voltage that moves the fade, or in red as a trigger that flips between full A and full B

inputs.text: Moves that fade, 5V covering half the knob's travel at full trim, or flips it on each trigger in trigger mode
The A side of that section
The B side of that section

outputs.text: Carries that section blended by its fade and the master fade
Carries that section blended the other way round, strongest in A where the plain output is strongest in B

notes: to fade all four with the master alone, leave the four section knobs centred and their jacks empty
trigger mode on the master and trigger mode on a section work against each other; the maker suggests picking one or the other
menu: Fade-mode (scaling of fade-knob/input): Logarithmic, Linear, Exponential — bends how the fade moves across the knob's travel
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it
